The observed payloads (`authorized: false, via: null, role: developer, sudo: false` for web-2 and db-1; `enabled: true, realm_role: developer, authorized_hosts: [dev-ws-1, jump-box-1, office-ws-1], sudo_hosts: [office-ws-1]`) are point-in-time configuration that reads identically whether or not dev.dana ran the four sshpass attempts — the failed password auths against web-2 write no row into an identity record. The oracle's empty projection therefore asserts no change to this envelope, which matches the state-only reading; it invents nothing and suppresses nothing. Omitting the static records themselves is a granularity/scope choice about routine rows present with or without the activity, not an unrepresented delta.
